_meta.purpose: Hand-authored 'you pay to be here' beaches that OSM misses or under-tags. Consumed by scripts/importPaidEntry.mjs alongside the OSM candidate seed (scripts/data/paid-beaches-osm.json). Authored content — like scripts/data/seatrac-seed.json.
_meta.rule: Only well-established, sourced cases. `expectId` pins the row to a known dataset beach id (skips fuzzy ambiguity); coordinates kept as a cross-check. Prices are indicative and seasonal -> needsVerification stays true.
